persona.name: Tom Gruber

occupation.title: Corn and Soybean Farmer
occupation.organization: Operates 900 acres of family ground outside Grinnell, Iowa
occupation.description: Fourth-generation farmer running the operation with his son-in-law. Days are equipment, weather apps, and grain markets. Walks miles of field edges without ever calling it exercise.

persona.education: Two-year ag business degree from Des Moines Area Community College; the rest learned on the land.
long_term_goals: Transition the farm to his daughter and son-in-law over ten years
Keep his cholesterol down enough to stay off a second medication
Fix up the '72 John Deere for the county fair
Take an actual vacation during a growing season, once, to prove he can
persona.style: Speaks slowly, in short declaratives, with long comfortable silences that make city people nervous. Judges every product by whether it survives him, and prices everything against useful things — 'that's half a tractor tire' is a real sentence he says. Politely immune to trends; grimly amused that sneakers now cost what boots do.

interests: The doctor-suggested evening walks with his wife
likes: One pair of sneakers that handles everything
Things made where the label says
Walking the dog to the creek and back
dislikes: Choices — twelve models of the same shoe
Ordering shoes online without trying them

beliefs: If it can't get dirty it isn't equipment, it's jewelry
Pay for what lasts, skip what impresses
A walk after supper fixes more than the news does
skills: Reading weather better than the app
Making anything last two seasons longer than designed

general: Walks two miles with his wife after supper, doctor's suggestion he pretends is hers
Owns one pair of sneakers, bought at Theisen's, replaced when the sole separates
Wears work boots for everything the sneakers don't cover
Asks his daughter to order things online, then pays her cash

morning: Up at 5, coffee, equipment check, markets on the radio
Field work by first light in season
workday: Planting, spraying, fixing, hauling — whatever the season demands
Dinner at noon, the big meal
evening: Supper at 6, walk with Carol after
weekend: Saturday same as weekdays in season
Sunday church, family dinner, one guilt-free nap

health.physical: Farm-strong with high cholesterol, a bad rotator cuff from a 2019 auger incident, and feet that have worn boots for 40 years.
health.mental: Steady as fence posts; carries harvest-season stress in his jaw and says he doesn't.

relationships.name: Carol
relationships.description: A retired elementary teacher who instituted the evening walks and bought him his current sneakers two Christmases ago.

relationships.name: Jake
relationships.description: Runs half the operation now; wears trail running shoes in the field, which Tom finds quietly hilarious.
